exampleSentence: Only two sailors survived the shipwreck.
exampleTranslation: 只有两名水手在这次海难中幸存。

exampleSentence: He wore a clean white shirt to the interview.
exampleTranslation: 他穿了一件干净的白色衬衫去面试。

exampleSentence: She began to shiver in the cold wind.
exampleTranslation: 她开始在寒风中发抖。

exampleSentence: The news of the accident came as a shock to everyone.
exampleTranslation: 事故的消息让所有人都感到震惊。

exampleSentence: My left shoe has a hole in the sole.
exampleTranslation: 我左脚的鞋底有一个洞。

exampleSentence: The guard was ordered not to shoot unless the intruder moved.
exampleTranslation: 警卫接到命令，除非闯入者移动，否则不得开枪。

exampleSentence: The shop on the corner sells fresh bread every morning.
exampleTranslation: 街角的商店每天早上出售新鲜面包。

exampleSentence: The shopkeeper greeted every customer with a smile.
exampleTranslation: 店主微笑着迎接每一位顾客。

exampleSentence: We walked along the shore and watched the sunset.
exampleTranslation: 我们沿着岸边散步，看着日落。

exampleSentence: A severe water shortage forced the city to limit daily use.
exampleTranslation: 严重的水资源短缺迫使该市限制日常用水。

exampleSentence: We took a shortcut through the park to reach the station faster.
exampleTranslation: 我们穿过公园抄近路，以便更快到达车站。

exampleSentence: The tailor agreed to shorten the sleeves by two centimeters.
exampleTranslation: 裁缝同意把袖子缩短两厘米。

exampleSentence: The company reported a shortfall of two million dollars in its budget.
exampleTranslation: 公司报告预算中出现了两百万美元的资金缺口。

exampleSentence: The reporter used shorthand to record the interview quickly.
exampleTranslation: 记者用速记快速记录采访内容。

exampleSentence: The train will arrive shortly, so please stand behind the yellow line.
exampleTranslation: 火车很快就要到站，请站在黄线后面。

exampleSentence: You should drink more water when the weather is hot.
exampleTranslation: 天气热的时候，你应该多喝水。

exampleSentence: He carried the heavy bag on his right shoulder.
exampleTranslation: 他把沉重的包扛在右肩上。

exampleSentence: She had to shout to be heard over the crowd.
exampleTranslation: 她不得不大声喊叫，才能盖过人群的声音。

exampleSentence: He shoved the heavy box across the floor.
exampleTranslation: 他用力把沉重的箱子推过地板。

exampleSentence: He used a shovel to clear the snow from the driveway.
exampleTranslation: 他用铲子清除车道上的积雪。

exampleSentence: She will show us how to use the new software.
exampleTranslation: 她会向我们演示如何使用这个新软件。

exampleSentence: I take a quick shower every morning before breakfast.
exampleTranslation: 我每天早上吃早饭前快速洗个淋浴。

exampleSentence: The girl shrieked when she saw the spider on her bed.
exampleTranslation: 女孩看到床上的蜘蛛时尖叫起来。

exampleSentence: The shrill sound of the alarm woke everyone in the building.
exampleTranslation: 警报发出的尖锐声音吵醒了楼里的所有人。

exampleSentence: The restaurant serves grilled shrimp with garlic butter.
exampleTranslation: 这家餐厅供应配蒜香黄油的烤虾。
